candidate_relations.reason: A mature cystic teratoma in the posterior fossa can present as a cystic cerebellar-region tumor, but this label does not identify the required mature teratoma subtype.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Broad anatomic and morphologic description lacking teratomatous histology and maturity.

candidate_relations.reason: Hemangioblastoma is histologically distinct from the benchmark diagnosis of mature cystic teratoma.
Although the cystic cerebellar location overlaps, hemangioblastoma is a distinct neoplasm and is not equivalent to a mature cystic teratoma.
